description: Update a product's name, description, delivery link/note, or price. USE THIS to set delivery_url when a product was created without one — that's how buyers receive what they bought (shown on the thank-you page and receipt). A subscription price change applies to NEW subscribers only — existing subscribers keep renewing at the price they signed up for; tell the seller that when repricing one.

delivery_note.description: Short instructions shown with the access button

delivery_url.description: Where buyers access this product — download URL, course/members login, or booking link (https only)

price_cents.description: New price. On a subscription this reaches new subscribers only — existing ones keep their agreed price

name: update_product
title: Update product
